note: MACHINE-READABLE COMPANION to docs/LAWS.md (the SOLE AUTHORITY for the current laws). Authored once; tools/lint-docs.mjs VERIFIES it against the LAWS.md law-to-probe table on every run, so it cannot drift: every id must exist in the table, every status must agree, every probe anchor must agree, and every retired rule's `since` tag must appear in LAWS.md. The retiredRules[] vocabularies below are the machine form of the retired rules LAWS.md states in prose - they replace the five hard-coded English phrases that used to live inside the lint (a list of past bugs, which any rewording escaped).

R1.what: the projectile-spine rule (ranged weapons deal no spine damage) and the shield's tangential no-damage clause - shot law 7s was its last remnant
R1.note: A line stating a retired form is an ERROR unless the line itself marks it as history (retired / was / no longer / used to / instead / since allcut-r62). LAWS.md must also state the LIVE form affirmatively - a subject plus a damage verb with no negation - so deleting the live rule is caught too, not only re-adding the old one.

staleCounts.why: shot law 7s was retired; six shot laws are live (1s-6s)

budgets.note: The canonical's comment layer may not exceed this many characters. It was 195,690 before the 2026-11-19 audit (audit finding W-01: 47% of the file, 49,329 tokens, and the file is loaded IN FULL by every agent that touches the game). It is 180,852 now: the audit removed the owner quotes, the who/when and the record of rejected approaches, and then the TRAIT/SKILL REGISTRY was corrected - the old one named six trait axes while the rows declare nine, and named three shot axes that no row declares. The budget exists so the layer cannot re-grow: the WHY stays, the archaeology does not. The audit estimated ~56KB of removable archaeology; the realised removal was ~16KB, because most of the bytes in an owner/date-bearing comment are the LIVE LAW attached to the attribution, and the owner's ruling keeps the law.
